text:
lee: quick thought  for the auto-fallback rollout UX: can we surface the sampling strategy alongside the decision preview? operators should see 'we sampled 2% of traffic => preview estimate +/- X%'.

anika: yes. also show a little link "why this request would fallback" on sample crumbs so you don't have to open full trace. short explanation + reason code is enough.

tom: +1. proposal: breadcrumb = tiny tuple (r,sc,f,aid,sv) where sv=signal_version. example: ```json
{"r":"latency","sc":0.78,"f":"quant-lite","aid":"g7h8","sv":3}
```

carla: storage/retention: keep crumbs 365d by default, full traces 21d. but add a tunable "investigate-on-score" window that causes the pipeline to persist full trace when sc in [0.45,0.65] or when operator clicks inspect.

lee: good tradeoff. also add a checkbox on console: "persist full trace when score near threshold" that orgs can opt out of. microcopy: "Saves full decision traces for borderline fallbacks to help debugging; increases storage."

anika: UI preview: show two numbers next to each preset: "estimated fallback % (24h)" and "estimated extra cost / day". hover shows assumptions (sample rate, lookback window).

tom: telemetry question: how do we generate preview without hitting production path? use sampled histograms and run sim in preview service. label all preview events sim=true.

carla: audit requirement: sims must be excluded from compliance exports. telemetry-bot: log this as a hard rule.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: rule recorded: preview/sim events tagged sim=true; compliance export filters by sim=false.

lee: edge-case: routes with strict contracts (billing, identity) should have immutable defaults. add per-route lock that requires platform-admin to unlock. show small lock icon in UI.

anika: escape hatch UX: per-route quick-rollback button plus a global "pause automatic fallback" that requires 2 approvals. show confirmation with estimated impact and post a smoke-check to #incidents automatically.

tom: small optimization: breadcrumb schema use short keys to reduce bytes: r->reason, sc->s, f->fallback, aid->id, sv->v. example: ```json
{"reason":"err_rate","s":0.54,"fallback":"small-quant","id":"k3l2","v":1}
```

carla: please ensure backward-compatible decoder in ingestion pipeline. add telemetry CI check for schema variants.

lee: action items: 1) @tom draft compact breadcrumb schema PR + decoder. 2) @anika mock console rows with sample-rate + cost estimate (Figma). 3) @carla run storage/cost estimates for crumbs at 100B/200B sizes and 2k/5k QPS. 4) I'll write microcopy and RBAC notes.

anika: minor: show a warning when retention change will increase org bill with a ballpark number and link to billing docs.

tom: I'll post schema draft and a small sim run output later today.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: staging sim scheduled at 06:00 UTC. all preview events will be tagged sim=true.

lee: great, if staging numbers look sane we'll propose defaults for the next weekly platform sync. thanks all :thumbsup:
